
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhuweisky/p/20170740" title="发布于 2026-05-26 15:28">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">uni-app 实现视频聊天、屏幕分享，支持Android、HarmonyOS、iOS</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        之前我们基于.NET Core实现过一个PC端 视频聊天和远程桌面的Demo （支持Windows、信创Linux），现在基于uni-app强大的跨平台能力，我们来为这个Demo增加手机APP端，以支持主流手机，包括安卓、iOS、纯血鸿蒙。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　uni-app 作为国内主流的手机APP开发框架，一套代码，可以同时支持安卓、苹果和纯血鸿蒙（HarmonyOS），真是太方便了。当要开发在多种手机设备上运行的APP时，这会为我们节省大量的时间成本。</p>
<p>　　之前我们基于.NET Core实现过一个PC端&nbsp;<a href="https://blog.oraycn.com/OMCS_Demo_VideoChatMini.aspx" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">视频聊天和远程桌面的Demo</a>&nbsp;（支持Windows、信创Linux），现在基于uni-app强大的跨平台能力，我们来为这个Demo增加手机APP端（并且使得APP端与PC端可以互通）。虽然，不同的手机系统上调用的底层的音视频API不一样，但我们将其封装成统一的uni-app模块，这样在uni-app层，就可以统一调用了。现在，我们来看看具体的实现过程，文末有Demo源码可以下载。</p>
<h2>一. 开发环境</h2>
<div>
<p>开发工具：HBuilderX 5.04</p>
<p>开发语言：VUE3+JS</p>
<p>测试手机：华为 Mate 60 Pro （纯血鸿蒙） 、小米16 、 iPhone 12</p>
<p>HarmonyOS：6.0.0</p>
<p>Andriod：16</p>
<p>IOS：17.0.2&nbsp;</p>
<h2>二．<strong>功能介绍</strong></h2>
<div>　　手机端登录成功后，运行的主界面如下图所示：&nbsp;&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522103406969-474290635.jpg" alt="微信图片_20260522103347_58_74" width="243" height="505" loading="lazy">&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<h3>1. 视频聊天</h3>
<p class="p">（1）每个登录的用户都可向其他任意在线用户发送视频聊天请求。</p>
<p class="p">（2）当收到来自其他在线用户的视频聊天邀请时，可接受或拒绝对方的请求。</p>
<p class="p">（3）当接受其他在线用户的视频聊天邀请时，即可开启视频聊天。&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="p">2. 屏幕分享</h3>
<p class="p">（1）每个登录的用户都可向其他任意在线用户发送屏幕分享请求；当对方未响应时，可主动取消屏幕分享请求。</p>
<p class="p">（2）当收到来自其他在线用户请求屏幕分享时，可接受或拒绝对方的请求。</p>
<p class="p">（3）当发送方收到其他在线用户同意屏幕分享时，即可观看对方的屏幕。</p>
<h2>三．<strong>具体实现</strong></h2>
<div><strong>&nbsp;</strong>下面我们讲一下Demo中核心的代码实现</div>
<div>
<h3><strong>1.自定义消息类型 InformationTypes</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>export const <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">informationType</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 视频请求
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

VideoRequest: </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 回复视频请求的结果
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
VideoResult: </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 通知对方 挂断 视频连接
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
CloseVideo: </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 通知好友 网络原因，导致 视频中断
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
NetReasonCloseVideo: </span>3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 通知对方(忙线中) 挂断 视频连接
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
BusyLine: </span>4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 远程桌面请求
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DesktopRequest: </span>5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 回复远程桌面请求的结果
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DesktopResult: </span>6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 主动取消远程桌面请求
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
CancelDesktop: </span>7<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 对方（主人端）主动断开远程桌面
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
OwnerCloseDesktop: </span>8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
* 客人端断开远程桌面连接
* </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
GuestCloseDesktop: </span>9<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>

<h3>2. 发送视频请求</h3>
<p>（1）当发起视频聊天时，将显示视频聊天窗口,并发送视频连接请求</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过import导入OMCS插件包里的多媒体管理器类以及其他连接器类    </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import {
        MultimediaManagerFactory,
        DesktopConnector,
        CameraConnector,
        MicrophoneConnector
    } from </span>"../OMCS/OMCS-Uni"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">获取到多媒体管理器</span>
const multimediamanager =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MultimediaManagerFactory.GetSingleton()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发起视频聊天请求函数</span>
const goVideo = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送视频连接请求 　　<br>multimediamanager.SendCustomizedMessage(ownerID.value,informationType.VideoRequest,[0],'')</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">getConnector(ownerID.value)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">跳转到视频请求页面</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    uni.navigateTo({
            url: `</span>/pages/videoPage?userID=${userID.value}&amp;ownerID=${ownerID.value}&amp;isMyRequest=${1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}`
        })
    } </span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;（2）连接自己的摄像头，预览自己的视频:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过uniapp的条件编译，区分鸿蒙与ios和android            </span>
&lt;!-- #ifdef APP-HARMONY --&gt;
            &lt;view class="toolBox" @touchmove="drag" @touchstart="drag" @touchend="drag"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

                &lt;/HmosCameraSurfaceViewVue&gt;
            &lt;/view&gt;
            &lt;!-- #endif --&gt;

            &lt;!-- #ifndef APP-HARMONY --&gt;
            &lt;view class="toolBox" @touchmove="drag" @touchstart="drag" @touchend="drag"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                :style</span>="`z-index: 9999;position: fixed; left: ${cameraLeft}px; top: ${cameraTop}px;`"&gt;
                &lt;CameraSurfaceView class="selfVideoView" ref="selfCameraView"&gt;
                &lt;/CameraSurfaceView&gt;
            &lt;/view&gt;
            &lt;!-- #endif --&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">ios与android，端需要获取控件实例，然后调用控件里的方法设置控件,鸿蒙端直接使用我们封装好的HmosCameraSurfaceViewVue，就可以预览自己的视频</span>
const selfCameraView = ref(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在onReady里设置控件</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
onReady(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
console.log(selfCameraView.value);
selfCameraView.value.setVideo()
})</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</pre>

<p>（3）当发送聊天邀请时，将显示视频邀请窗口&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<h3>3. 回复对方视频请求</h3>
<p>（1）当收到对方的视频聊天邀请时，将显示视频邀请窗口&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<h3>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522110740054-1836565764.jpg" alt="微信图片_20260522110659_60_74" width="243" height="505" loading="lazy"></h3>
<p>&nbsp; （2）发送回复视频聊天请求消息</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">挂断    </span>
const handsup = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送挂断消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MultimediaManagerFactory.GetSingleton().SendCustomizedMessage(ownerID.value, informationType.CloseVideo, [],</span>''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isRequestVideo.value) {
            uni.disConnector()
        }
        isRequestVideo.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        isMyRequest.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        uni.navigateBack();
    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">接听</span>
    const answer = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送接听消息</span>
MultimediaManagerFactory.GetSingleton().SendCustomizedMessage(ownerID.value, informationType.VideoResult, [1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
            </span>''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        isRequestVideo.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        timer()
        requestCamera()
    }</span></pre>

<h3>4. 收到对方发送过来的消息回调</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        multimediamanager.setCustomMessageReceivedCallback((res) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
　　　　　　　　　</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">res为服务端返回过来的JSON数据</span>
                 const message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSON.parse(res)
                requestID.value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> message.SourceUserID
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (message.InformationType) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.VideoRequest:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">有人发出视频邀请</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cameraConnector.value == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; microphoneConnector.value == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                            getConnector(message.SourceUserID)
                        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                            console.log(</span>"正在通话中"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        }
                        uni.navigateTo({
                            url: `</span>/pages/videoPage?userID=${userID.value}&amp;ownerID=${requestID.value}&amp;isMyRequest=${0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}`
                        });
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.VideoResult:
                       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//对方</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">回复视频邀请请求</span>
                        const res = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stream(message.Content)
                        const videoBool </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res.readBoolean()
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (videoBool) {
                            isRequestVideo1.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                            uni.showToast({
                                position: </span>"bottom"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                                title: </span>"对方挂断"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                            })
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isRequestVideo1.value) {
                                disConnector()
                            }
                            isRequestVideo1.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        }<br>　　　
                        uni.$emit(</span>'updateVideoResult'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {
                            isRequestVideo: isRequestVideo1.value
                        })
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.CloseVideo:
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isRequestVideo1.value) {
                            disConnector()
                        }
                        uni.showToast({
                            position: </span>"bottom"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                            title: </span>"对方挂断了音视频邀请"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        })
                        uni.navigateBack()
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.DesktopRequest:
                        console.log(</span>"有人请求远程桌面"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                        ownerID.value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> message.SourceUserID
                        popup.value.open()
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.DesktopResult:
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">请求远程桌面的回复</span>
                        const stream = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stream(message.Content)
                        const bool </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stream.readBoolean()
                        console.log(bool);
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (bool) {
                            console.log(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifndef APP-HARMONY</span>
                            desktopConnector.value = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DesktopConnector(requestID.value)
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>
                            console.log(2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifndef APP-HARMONY</span>
                            uni.__desktopConnector =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> desktopConnector.value
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>
                            console.log(3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            uni.navigateTo({
                                url: `</span>/pages/desktop?destUserID=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${ownerID.value}`
                            })

                            isScreenShareRequest.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                            uni.showToast({
                                position: </span>"bottom"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                                title: </span>"对方拒绝了屏幕分享请求"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                            })
                            isScreenShareRequest.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        }
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>

                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.CancelDesktop:
　　　　　　　　　　　　
                        uni.showToast({
                            position: </span>"bottom"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                            title: </span>"对方主动断开了桌面连接"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        })
                        popup.value.close()
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.OwnerCloseDesktop:
                        uni.reLaunch({
                            url: `</span>/pages/home?userID=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${userID.value}`
                        })
                        uni.showToast({
                            position: </span>"bottom"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                            title: </span>"对方主动断开了桌面连接"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        })
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifndef APP-HARMONY</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                        desktopConnector.value.disconnect()
                        uni.__desktopConnector </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>

                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.GuestCloseDesktop:
                        multimediamanager.stopScreenBroadcast()


                        isSomeoneWatchScreen.value </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                }
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (err) {
                console.log(err);
            }

        })</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;　　 当对方回复同意时，将连接到对方的麦克风和摄像头，开始视频聊天会话</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>onLoad((e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
console.log(e);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">监听对方是否同意视频连接</span>
uni.$on('updateVideoResult', (data) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置是否打开麦克风</span>

})

const requestCamera </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        uni.cameraConnector.beginConnect()
        uni.microphoneConnector.beginConnect()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifndef APP-HARMONY</span>

<p>　　 视频会话的UI效果如下图所示：&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522114155047-287311347.jpg" alt="微信图片_20260522114138_61_74" width="243" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>5. 实现屏幕分享</h3>
<p class="p">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;屏幕分享的请求/应答逻辑几乎与视频聊天请求/应答逻辑是一模一样的。这里就不再罗列响应的代码了。</p>
<p class="p">　　&nbsp; 下面的截图是以Windows与鸿蒙手机端互动为例：Windows端作为请求方，手机端作为应答方。（反过来也是一样的）</p>
<p>（1）PC端发起请求&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522114306304-1595813050.png" alt="image" width="411" height="134" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（2）手机端收到对方的屏幕分享请求时，将显示请求窗口。&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522114407472-1855747761.jpg" alt="90f0ad11025667b66a9120f596ed2e8e" width="243" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;（3）当手机端同意请求时，PC端就可以观看手机的屏幕了。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522114618942-1816153592.png" alt="QQ_1779421573219" width="594" height="335" loading="lazy">&nbsp;</p>
<h2>&nbsp;四.不同端的配置</h2>
<p>&nbsp;（1）由于苹果和安卓使用的是uniapp的原生语言插件，鸿蒙使用的是uts原生混编，所以插件的配置会有些许不同</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522142530457-1511039466.png" alt="QQ_1779431124597" width="390" height="505" loading="lazy"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522142629093-1129958932.png" alt="QQ_1779431181279" width="352" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　如图所示，安卓苹果插件需要放在nativeplugins目录下，而鸿蒙插件需要放在uni_modules目录下。并且，安卓苹果的插件，需要通过uniapp云打包后，才能使用，鸿蒙直接运行即可。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260522144201408-1466739941.png" alt="QQ_1779432114469" width="462" height="315" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　导入插件并且打包完后，安卓苹果便可以通过uni.requireNativePlugin来获取插件实例，鸿蒙直接通过import就可以获取到插件。&nbsp;</p>
<h2>五. 源码下载</h2>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 16px">1. uni-app 端：<strong><a href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/VideoChatMini-uniapp.rar" rel="noopener nofollow">VideoChatMini-uniapp.rar</a></strong> （支持Android、iOS、HarmonyOS）</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 16px">2. 服务端 + PC 端：<strong><a href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/VideoChatMini.rar" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">VideoChatMini.rar</a></strong>&nbsp; （支持Windows、Linux、银河麒麟、统信UOS）</span></p>
<p>　　在这里，我也给出了服务端和PC端的源码，服务端和PC端都是 C# 开发的（开发环境是 VS2022），跨平台使用的是.NET Core 。</p>
<p>　　如此一来，所有的PC之间、所有的手机之间、以及所有的手机和PC之间，都可以互通的，也就是可以相互视频通话，以及观看屏幕/桌面。</p>
<p>　　关于这个Demo，如果你有好的建议，请留言给我，谢谢。&nbsp;</p>
